name: Thomas Taylor Memorial Skatepark
note: The skate spot of #222. `center` is the pad center [x, z] in level meters; `axis` is the direction of the pad's long side (+u) as a unit [x, z]; `size` is [length along u, width along v] in m. +v is 90 degrees clockwise from +u seen from above (+z south), so v grows to the south-southeast here. A feature has `at` [u, v] (its model origin, the ground center) and `turn` in degrees: 0 puts the model's long side (+x) along +u and its front (+z) along +v; a positive turn is counterclockwise seen from above. Feature ids are the keys of assets/skate-features/features.json.

placement.source: OpenStreetMap way 182470291 (leisure=pitch, sport=skateboard): the center 33.76472, -84.36039 as recorded in docs/research/2026-11-02-stage-accuracy-and-characters.md, which is [264.4, 3.3] in level meters. The outline of the way is not in levels/beltline-eastside/raw/, so the pad is a 30 m by 14 m rectangle on that center, along the middle line between the OSM paths w182470305 and w186813134.
